name: whisperx-core
description: WhisperX C++ engine core — ONNX Runtime + sherpa-onnx reimplementation of the WhisperX pipeline (see docs/cpp-core-handoff.md).

dependencies.name: ffmpeg
dependencies.$comment: LGPL build (no gpl/nonfree, native AAC, no fdk-aac) for the Phase-2B in-process libav* decode; trim demux/decode to what we load.

$notes: sherpa-onnx is not in the vcpkg registry; it is vendored / built from source via CMake FetchContent for the silero VAD (Phase 2B) and the ASR/diarize stages (Phase 4) — it brings its own ONNX Runtime. Phase 2B's in-process audio decode links ffmpeg's libav* (declared here for the production toolchain; the dev build / CI use the matching system ffmpeg-dev via pkg-config, which CMake's WHISPERX_CORE_AUDIO path finds either way). The light deps (nlohmann-json, pybind11, catch2) are also pulled via CMake FetchContent so a fresh checkout builds without a vcpkg bootstrap; pass the vcpkg toolchain file to resolve them (and the heavy deps) from vcpkg instead.
